text:
emma: opened a small PR adding a migration note + two tiny SDK snippets (Ruby + Rust) for the console cost/latency card. trying to cover tracekey grouping and a short troubleshooting line. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1338 :sparkles:

jay: saw it, nice. Can we prefer dashboard ID links rather than names? we had drift on DB names previously. Recommend: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/DB-301-cost-latency

carla: agree on ID. also: our metric aliases are a mess for prefetch vs kv cache. please add a migration tip: "If charts show zeros, confirm alias mapping (runtime metric -> console metric) and check the deploy redirect."

emma: added migration tip and switched to the dashboard ID. pasted tiny snippets (4-6 lines) so they fit in the quick card. opted for `tracekey` one-word since SDKs normalize that.

emma: ```rb
# Ruby snippet: attach tracekey to group cost by prefix
resp = client.generate(prompt, metadata: {"tracekey" => "team-7/promo"})
# on cache hit: Metrics.increment("kv_cache_hits")
```

emma: ```rust
// Rust example: include tracekey and emit a hit metric
let resp = client.generate(prompt).metadata("tracekey","org/blue").send().await?;
// on hit: metrics::increment("kv_cache_hits");
```

jay: nit: change metrics name to kv_cache_hit_total in the troubleshooting line? console expects that alias. we should call out the mapping explicitly: kv_cache_hits -> kv_cache_hit_total.

carla: also add a one-liner about TTLs: "Short TTLs increase miss rate and token spend."

emma: updated mapping line and TTL sentence. kept examples minimal per UX ask.

docs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR #1338 but linkcheck flagged external console link as external; add comment if intentional.

infra-bot: FYI scheduled platform alias update in next deploy window (22:00 UTC). redirect to DB-301 will be created after deploy.

emma: action items: 1) infra to push alias + redirect 2) jay to confirm runtime metric emits mapping in staging 3) carla to quick-check wording 4) emma will squash and request final review. pinging when CI comments are addressed. thanks! :pray:
